subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep #41372 open as the broad routing umbrella, or split/link the remaining slices to narrower canonical issues and then close the umbrella?
rationale: Current main proves partial fixes and several open canonical trackers, but deciding whether a broad production field report remains useful is a maintainer workflow and product-scope choice across multiple owner surfaces.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link #85695, #55792, #82662, and other validated slices, open any missing focused current-main follow-ups, then close #41372 as superseded by owner-scoped work.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave #41372 open until every slice is fixed, rejected, or moved, accepting that it remains hard to validate automatically.

options.title: Close as partially superseded
options.body: Close now with links to existing narrower issues and ask users to file fresh issues for weaker slices if they recur with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link #85695, #55792, #82662, and other validated slices, open any missing focused current-main follow-ups, then close #41372 as superseded by owner-scoped work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is cross-surface routing and product-scope work, and steipete has recent history across cron, Discord, docs, onboarding, and gateway context.
